reviewerSteps: Launch the signed build and select Finnish, English, or Spanish from Profile.
Sign in with the synthetic reviewer account supplied only in the store dashboard.
Open Today or Picks and inspect sports-analysis probabilities, prices, confidence, freshness, and risk information.
Open Agent and verify that explanations are decision support only and may downgrade a paper decision when evidence is weak.
Save a virtual paper selection and verify that the bankroll and stake are clearly virtual.
Open Tracking and inspect paper result, ROI, CLV, and settlement information when test data is available.
Open Profile and verify language persistence, privacy/help links, data export, and the account-deletion flow.
Verify that no screen offers deposits, withdrawals, payment methods, bookmaker login, or real-money bet execution.
reviewNotes: Some live sports data depends on provider availability and event timing; missing data must fail closed rather than fabricate a pick.

Account deletion is destructive and should be tested only with the disposable synthetic review/test account.
Automatic model promotion remains disabled; learning features are shadow-only unless separately approved through production gates.
